about_the_game:
This DLC is a digital version of a prequel bonus light novel for the original game. It can be opened within the game. It does not meet the standards of a visual novel, as we currently lack the resources to produce it as such. However, within the limits of our available resources, we have still implemented some basic animations and background music to enhance immersion.

This story has a length of 40,000 Chinese characters. It contains the story events that occurred before the game, as well as an alternate possibility for the story of the protagonist and Irene. We do not intend to give too many details and recommend that you try this DLC after completing the original game's endings, if you wish to learn more about the finer and complete details of the setting and story.

After installing the DLC, you can click the DLC button on the main menu to access this story.

If this product achieves relatively substantial profits, we will continue to develop it into a full visual novel format, adding corresponding CGs, character sprites, and animations. This will be updated directly to this DLC, requiring no additional payment from you.
